text: Feerick Property are pleased to present this substantial detached residence, extending to approximately 250 sq. m., set on approximately 10.7 acres in a private and mature setting close to the shores of Lough Corrib. Oaklands is approached via a private driveway with electric gated access and occupies a particularly attractive setting within its own grounds. Approximately 1.5 acres are laid out in grass, with the remainder comprising mature native woodland. The woodland includes a variety of species, including oak, silver birch, willow and alder, together with more recently planted apple trees, creating a private and natural setting. The residence provides spacious and well-appointed accommodation over two floors and has been finished to a high standard throughout. Constructed with hollowcore floors, the property benefits from an impressive B Building Energy Rating (BER), solid oak internal doors and a combination of solid wood and ceramic tiled flooring throughout the ground floor, with carpeted flooring to the first floor. The ground floor accommodation comprises a spacious and bright entrance hallway, a dual-aspect living room with feature fireplace and solid wood flooring, and an open-plan kitchen/dining room with adjoining conservatory. The kitchen is fitted with white gloss units and quality appliances, while the tiled floor continues through this bright and practical living space. There are three generously proportioned double bedrooms on the ground floor, each with its own ensuite and walk-in wardrobe. A further room provides flexibility for use as a home office, playroom or additional bedroom. The ground floor is further complemented by a family bathroom with separate bath and shower, a utility room and a generously sized hot press. The first floor accommodates two further spacious bedrooms, both with ensuite facilities and walk-in wardrobes. A substantial detached garage, with floor area of approximately 130 square metres, provides excellent additional space and flexibility. The ground floor incorporates a large workshop area with two large double doors, while the first floor has been partially converted to provide potential additional living accommodation. Constructed with hollowcore flooring, the building offers considerable scope for a variety of uses and may provide potential for an additional income stream, subject to the necessary planning consents and requirements. There is also a separate gardening shed and wood store, incorporating an up-and-over door, providing further practical storage space. The property enjoys a private rural setting while remaining conveniently accessible to a range of local amenities and attractions. The shores of Lough Corrib are located approximately 900 metres away, while the popular village of Cong is just a 10-minute drive. Galway City can be reached in approximately 40 minutes, with Ireland West Airport Knock and Shannon Airport located approximately one hour and 90 minutes away respectively. The location offers an attractive balance of rural privacy and accessibility, with the renowned amenities of Lough Corrib and the wider Cong area close at hand. This is a substantial and well-finished family residence offering generous and flexible accommodation, extensive private grounds, mature woodland and versatile outbuildings in an attractive location close to Lough Corrib and Cong.

address: Lower Main Street, Foxford, Foxford, Co. Mayo, F26H6N9
text: Former Schoolhouse by the Moy | Main Street, Foxford, Co. Mayo A Historic Schoolhouse Beautifully Restored – RTÉ Home of the Year 2023 Grand Finalist This is a truly distinctive four-bedroom residence situated in the heart of Foxford, County Mayo. Dating back to circa 1930, this remarkable property has a fascinating history and holds a special place in the heritage of Foxford. From 1952 to 1961, the building served as a girls' secondary school, welcoming generations of local students through its doors. In 1977, the property entered private family ownership, beginning another chapter in its history. In 2019, the present owners embarked on an extensive renovation, completely transforming the former schoolhouse into the beautiful family home that stands today. The restoration was undertaken with great care and attention to detail, retaining the charm and character of this historic building while introducing the comforts and conveniences of modern living. The result is a home filled with warmth, individuality and character, where every room has its own appeal. The exceptional quality of the transformation received national recognition in 2023 when the property featured on RTÉ's Home of the Year, progressing to the grand final of the prestigious competition. Internally, the accommodation offers four bedrooms, four beautifully finished bathrooms, a welcoming kitchen and a wonderful selection of living and reception areas. Throughout the property, inviting corners, comfortable seating areas and thoughtfully designed spaces create a home that is both practical and full of personality. Its distinctive architecture, carefully chosen finishes and beautifully presented interiors reflect the considerable work and attention invested in bringing this historic residence back to life. Situated on Main Street in Foxford, the property enjoys a central location within walking distance of local shops, cafés and amenities. Foxford is renowned for its rich heritage, the famous River Moy and the historic Foxford Woollen Mills. This property offers a rare opportunity to acquire a home of genuine historical interest, beautifully restored and recognised nationally for its design and character. A property with a remarkable past, an exceptional transformation and a new chapter waiting to be written. Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate everything this unique residence has to offer. Contact CK Auctioneers for further details
